verdict: Google Ads is consuming most of the budget for almost no leads.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 32 tracked leads at an average cost of $122.46 per lead — but that average masks a sharp imbalance: Meta produced all 32 of those leads at roughly $44 each, while Google Ads consumed $2,508 (64% of total spend) and returned only 2 conversions. Google's cost per lead is running near $1,254, roughly 28 times Meta's rate, and budget is being shifted accordingly to stop the bleed. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark on two consecutive days this week, which is being investigated as a potential listing issue rather than a traffic fluctuation. You should expect a more efficient cost-per-lead number next period as Google spend is rebalanced and the profile issue is resolved.
